text: Ask me for my list next time. It has two names on it. Neither is mine.
style: A charismatic field coordinator in his early forties. British-Ghanaian, raised in Accra and educated in London: a consistent light, educated Ghanaian English accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Warm, mid-low pitch; quick, easy pace. Tonight he is at the raid table with his own list, auditing everyone.
